title: DNS over QUIC RFC 9250 Usage Profiles and Fallback Work Item
summary: Add DoqClientProfile enum, DoqFallbackCache class, and profile/fallback integration in DoqClient.
planned_changes:
- Add DoqClientProfile enum: Strict (no fallback) and Opportunistic (backoff).
- Add DoqFallbackCache class with RecordFailure, GetRemainingBackoff, IsBackedOff.
- Add DoqFallbackPolicy with explicit caller-owned fallback transport selection after DoQ connection failure: DoT preference, cleartext opt-in, and key-pinned cleartext suppression.
- Add Profile, FallbackCache, and KeyPinnedEndpoints properties to DoqClient.
- Add backoff check in QueryAsync for Opportunistic profile.
- Record failures in fallback cache on QuicException in QueryAsync.
- Add focused tests for Strict profile, Opportunistic fallback selection, conservative cleartext fallback, Opportunistic backoff, backoff expiry, and key-pinned override.
verification_plan: Run DoQ foundation tests, core SpecTrace JSON validation, and diff hygiene.
out_of_scope: DoT or cleartext DNS client implementation.
completion_notes: All 7 REQs are now traced and verified. Profile, fallback selection, conservative cleartext policy, and fallback-cache behavior are implemented with tests. DoT and cleartext DNS transport execution remains caller-owned and out of scope.
